title: Kerry-Lynne Findlay resigns as leader of the B.C. Conservative party

image.caption: Kerry-Lynne Findlay resigned as leader of the B.C. Conservatives on Sunday. (CBC News)

blocks.text: "This was not an easy decision, but I believe it is the right one for our movement and our province," she wrote in a statement Sunday.
The leader of the Conservative Party of British Columbia announced Sunday on social media she is resigning
The leader of B.C.'s Conservative Party has resigned.
Kerry-Lynne Findlay made the announcement in a social media post Sunday afternoon.
"This was not an easy decision, but I believe it is the right one for our movement and our province," she wrote.
Michelle Gomez is a writer and reporter at CBC Vancouver. You can contact her at michelle.gomez@cbc.ca.
